The Achilles’ heel of global trade: Building resilience where it matters most
articles.context: International trade has been resilient, but important vulnerabilities lurk beneath the surface
articles.full_text: International trade has been resilient, but important vulnerabilities lurk beneath the surface. Identifying and managing these Achilles’ heels could help unlock new markets, products, and economic growth.
